title: Information disclousure, password plaintext storage
body:
On request below application returns sensitive user information like password. 
It means also that passwords of users are stored in databese in plain text. It should be stored only as a hash of user password.

References: 
https://www.owasp.org/index.php/Information_Leak_(information_disclosure)
https://www.owasp.org/index.php/Password_Storage_Cheat_Sheet


comments.author: Participant 2
Participant 2
comments.body:
For the record. The result contains information about different users of the my-thai-star application like this:
```
"user": {
      "id":0,
      "modificationCounter":1,
      "revision":null,
      "username":"user0",
      "password":"password",
      "email":"user0@mail.com",
      "userRoleId":0
    }
```
We should never ever store and never never ever allow to retrieve passwords of users. This is completely inacceptable. If we would do so in an application for our customer even if there is no demand/requirement about this it would be a bug and we could easily get sued for such mistakes as IT security (at least for such obvious cases) is an implicit MUST requirement.

Also regarding GDPR (EU data privacy rights) we should be careful about personal data such as email addresses. It may be acceptable for an admin to retrieve a list of users with their email addresses, names, etc. but if regular users of the system (especially guests) may retrieve such personal data of other persons this is also a severe bug that could result in suing us and getting a expensive fine. Fortunately this is just a sample app with dummy data. However, as this app is "THE SAMPLE APP" of devonfw it IMHO is the blueprint how to do it right and has to have high quality what is currently not the case.
